title: Ed Garland's 111 band on Spring Street
summary: Howard played in bassist Ed Garland's six- or seven-piece band at the 111 Club about 1933, then formed a trio.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: How big a band was Ed Garland's band?
Not too big. Six or seven pieces.

Yeah, long as he played, up there, At the 111.
